ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure gives the distribution function F_X(x) of the random variable X. The curve has a vertical discontinuous jump at x=1: the function value before the jump is about 0.25, and the function value after the jump is about 0.55. Reasoning: The jump size of a CDF at a certain point equals the probability mass at that point. Therefore P(X=1)=F_X(1)-F_X(1^-)=0.55-0.25=0.30.
